integrity: Analytical zero-sum quadratic-form derivation; finite diagnostics are corroboration rather than proof. Self-assessment is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite unit-edge complete multipartite vertex metrics with r-2 singleton parts, r>=3, a,b>=1, a+b=u>=4. Does not classify general multipartite size vectors. Older broad two-distance spectral literature might implicitly imply this particular fixed-budget ordering; the 1990 primary full text was not obtained.
title: Balancing inversion for generalized roundness of two-heavy-part multipartite graph metrics
